Hi Christine — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes, we can operate Prod in EU-only mode and provide a bundle of operational artifacts; there are a couple of items that need a short internal runbook to produce (see below). Proposed next steps:

1) I'll schedule a 30-min tech review with our infra lead to confirm data flow diagrams and KMS ownership (proposed slots 2028-11-02).
2) We will produce an "evidence inventory" spreadsheet (artifact list + owner + ETA).
3) Legal will draft an SCCs addendum and attestation that we can share for signature (DocuSign) — Lauren is looped.

High-level notes:
- Data plane: customer payloads can be pinned to EU regions (Frankfurt/Paris) under an EU-only processing policy.
- Control plane: orchestration metadata (job scheduling, billing meta) by default lives in our control plane; for strict EU-only customers we offer a private control plane option or can export control-plane logs under NDA. We treat control-plane metadata as separate from customer input data.
- KMS: We support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-KMS) via standard Cloud KMS/HSM integrations; for Pharmadex we can provide key ownership assertions and key identifiers used for the EU tenant.
- Backups: incremental backups are encrypted and stored in-region by default for EU-hosted tenants; we will include retention windows and backup TTL in the artifact list.
- Deletion: our delete pipeline includes tombstone + scrub + overwrite steps. We provide proof-of-deletion artifacts (audit entries, job run IDs, backup snapshots removed or re-keyed).

I'll attach an initial inventory by EOD 2028-11-02. If you prefer, we can tie delivery to an NDA/PO; please advise.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi all — attaching the initial evidence inventory (see attachment) and a short technical summary below. I created an export folder we can hand over via secure transfer once legal signs the data transfer NDA.

Key artifacts we can deliver and the format:
- Audit log extract (CSV) — entries for all data-plane read/write/delete ops for tenant PHX-123 (time range configurable).
- KMS key statement (PDF) — shows key ID, region, creation policy; we can provide Cloud KMS key metadata and key-rotation history.
- Backup snapshot index (CSV) — list of snapshots, creation time, region tag, encryption status.
- Proof-of-deletion package (ZIP) — deletion job run logs, snapshot delete confirmations, and final audit timestamps.
- Control-plane metadata export (JSON/CSV) — only if Pharmadex confirms it needs EU residency; otherwise we provide schema and selective exports.

Deletion workflow (summary):
1) Customer initiates deletion request via API or our Console (creates a delete ticket).
2) Orchestration marks user data with tombstone and queues a scrub job.
3) Scrub job overwrites data blocks, updates KV cache and invalidates keys.
4) Snapshot/backup lifecycle job removes any dependent snapshots after retention TTL; we produce snapshot delete confirmations (object IDs + deletion timestamps).
5) We generate a proof-of-deletion ZIP containing job-run IDs, audit logs, and a signed checksum manifest.

Example command we run internally to generate proof-of-deletion (sanitized):
#!/bin/bash
# pseudodelete_script.sh (sanitized)
echo "Starting deletion proof bundle for tenant PHX-123"
# fetch job-run ids and logs
# tar/gzip proof files and sign with internal key

We will produce the redwood_evidence_inventory.xlsx (attached) and the pseudodelete_script.sh (sanitized) as part of the bundle. ETA: inventory + initial proof-of-deletion sample by 2028-11-07; full package by 2028-11-12 if control-plane export is requested.

Ben Carter
